title: Practice 5: Instrumental endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «смертью»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «надзирателем»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The soldiers were regarded as cannon fodder.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «мясом»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Our museum has a large collection of exhibits of flora and fauna of the sea.
exercises.ru: Наш музей обладает ___ коллекцией экспонатов флоры и фауны моря.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «коллекцией»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «практикой»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Okapis have to follow a diet low in sugar.
exercises.ru: Окапи должны соблюдать диету с ___ содержанием сахара.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «содержанием»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «страной»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The following year, the Ellice Islands became the separate British colony of Tuvalu.
exercises.ru: В следующем году острова Эллиса стали отдельной ___ колонией Тувалу.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «колонией»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Роуз поднялась удобрить ___ (розовый) икрой свои ряды роз.
exercises.prompt: Rose rose to put rose roes on her rows of roses.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «икрой»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «информацией»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «народом»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Agony in the era of machinery is not attributed to machinery itself.
exercises.ru: Агония в эру механизмов не связана с ___ механизмами.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «механизмами»: instrumental plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «ртом»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Air pollution is a serious problem in this country.
exercises.ru: В этой стране загрязнённость воздуха является ___ проблемой.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «проблемой»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «карамелью»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The building with the reddish brown roof is a church.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «крышей»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Частные компании работали рука об руку с ___ (местный) общинами.
exercises.prompt: Private companies have been working in conjunction with local communities.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «общинами»: instrumental plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tolkien was staunchly anti-racist and anti-authority.
exercises.ru: Толкин был ___ противником расизма и авторитаризма.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «противником»: instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
